title: Bought 2016, FMV on 31-Jan-2018 above cost, sold 2025 above FMV: tax cost = FMV; LTCG exceeds Rs 1.25 lakh
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.112A(2)/(1) read with s.55(2)(ac) (inserted by Finance Act 2018): for an equity share acquired before 1-Feb-2018, cost of acquisition = higher of (a) actual cost and (b) lower of FMV on 31-Jan-2018 and full value of consideration
Income-tax Act 1961 s.112A(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: 12.5 % on LTCG exceeding Rs 1,25,000 (transfers on/after 23-Jul-2024)
Health and Education Cess 4 % (Finance Act 2025 s.2)
derivation: Buy 2016-06-01: 400 @ 500.00 -> actual cost 2,00,000.00. FMV 31-Jan-2018 = 800.00/share. Charges 0 so gross consideration = net proceeds.
Per share: lower of FMV 800 and sale 1,200 = 800; higher of actual 500 and 800 = 800 -> tax_cost 400 x 800 = 3,20,000.00.
(Without grandfathering the gain would be 2,80,000 - this case detects a missing s.55(2)(ac).)
